name: Learn
question: Did the outcome claim come true, and what did avenCEO itself get wrong?
do: Measure the outcome claim. Use it daily; a first-time agent that can't read the code uses it like a newcomer.
avenCEO's own metrics are computed from the records of every intent.

A drift check (later) compares the spec (Architecture panels, rule IDs) with Lean and the code, and reports only the differences. Each rule ID links its theorem and its function, so the check stays mechanical.
Surprises become product intents. Signals about avenCEO become avenCEO intents, and they go through avenCEO itself (see How avenCEO improves itself).
Keep the full artifacts, never summaries.
who: The orchestrator, a first-time agent, machines.
from: Claude Code team: daily use, first-time user
